dict.string: Voga listens to the microphone during a live session to transcribe and fact-check what a candidate says. The audio stays on this computer.
Voga listens to this computer's sound during a live session (a debate or live stream playing here) to transcribe and fact-check it. The audio stays on this computer.
Voga connects to an Ollama server on your local network to index and answer questions about what it collected.
